## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Coordinate Convention"}
Measure beam coordinate <em>s</em> from the left free tip. Pin A is at <em>s</em> = <em>a</em>, cylinder point B at <em>s</em> = <em>a</em> + <em>b</em>, and payload point C at <em>s</em> = <em>a</em> + <em>b</em> + <em>L</em>.
:::
